Library.description: This SOA library provides the service interfaces that enable generation of a BOM. For instance generating an Engineering BOM from Design BOM and vice-versa.
Library.name: Pma1SoaBOMAutomation

ParameterInfo.description: A list of Awb0Element containing source BOMLIne objects for which target BOM structure is to be created. When targetOccurrence is NOT specified (null), this input should contain only one Awb0Element.
Contains the design context information using which the sourceOccurrences are configured. It includes revision rule, effectivity, variant rule or any such configuration criteria specified by user.
Awb0Element containing target BOMLine to which the target BOM structure is to be created. This can be null. When null, the target occurrence is inferred from top node of source occurrences.
A map (string, string) of additional options and its values. These options govern certain aspects of target BOM structure creation. It can be empty.

Operation.description:
This operation generates engineering BOM structure from source design BOM structure and aligns them. The operation identifies the source BOM structure type and generates relevant type of target BOM structure. Target BOM occurrences are created for the source BOM occurrences specified in the input. When an input source BOM occurrence is a sub-assembly (has structure beneath), the target BOM occurrence is generated for the whole sub-assembly. Multiple source BOM occurrences in the input should be siblings to each other. These newly generated target BOM occurrences are placed under the target BOM occurrence specified in the input. The source and target nodes must contain valid BOMLine objects.
Supported source and target type combination is as follows:
Source Type Target Type
Design BOM Engineering BOM
Engineering BOM Design BOM
Operation.name: generateTargetBOMFromSourceBOM
Operation.returnDescription:
Void. Since this is an asynchronous operation, there is no return value. In case of success, the user will be notified through a success message in the alerts section. In case of failure due to any of the following partial errors, the user will be notified through a message in the alerts section.
• 427005 sourceOccurrences do not belong to same parent.
• 427006 sourceOccurrences contain more than 1 elements when no targetOccurrence is specified.
• 427007 The given sourceOccurrence is not a valid Design or Part.
• 427008 The given targetOccurrence is not a valid Design or Part.
• 427009 The given combination of source and target is not supported.
Operation.useCase:
• Use case 1:
Design structure and engineering BOM structure is opened in CBA page. User selects
some design BOM occurrences and drags them on the target engineering BOM occurrence. This operation will create engineering BOM occurrences for the complete structure beneath the selected design BOM occurrences and place them under the target engineering BOM occurrence.

• Use case 2:
Engineering BOM structure and Design structure is opened in CBA page. User selects
some engineering BOM occurrences and drags them on the target design BOM occurrence. This operation will create design BOM occurrences for the complete structure beneath the selected engineering BOM occurrences and place them under target design BOM occurrence.

• Use case 3:
User selects the top occurrence of a BOM structure and invokes "Generate BOM" operation. This operation will then create target BOM structure for the complete input BOM structure. For example, for the input design BOM structure, complete engineering BOM structure is created and vice-versa.

ParameterInfo.description: The selected ChangeNoticeRevision from primary work area in Active Workspace.
The Awb0Element containing the source top BOMLine.
The Awb0Element containing the target top BOMLine.

Operation.description:
This operation retrieves update actions summary when a source ( Design or Part ) structure is modified in given input change revision.
This summary includes information of the modified source, its aligned target ( Design or Part ) and possible update actions such as revise, create, reuse etc for the target.
For each solution item in change, the update action is determined for aligned target item depending on the change action. The façade objects for the modified source and aligned target is also computed for highlighting the occurrences in the source and target structure.
Operation.name: getUpdateActionsSummary
Operation.returnDescription:
The response structure GetUpdateActionSummaryResponse which contains list of information to be rendered on the update Panel.
Following partial errors will be thrown:
•    427007 – The given sourceRootOcc is not a valid Design or Part.
•    427008 – The given targetRootOcc is not a valid Design or Part.
•    233004 – The given changeNoticeRevision is not a valid type.
Operation.useCase:
This operation is invoked in the following use-cases:
•    Use case 1:
Design structure and engineering BOM structure is opened in CBA page.
This operation will render the update panel with the following information:
Modified Design Revision, Aligned Part Revision and the update action to be performed on the Part Structure. On selecting the modified Design revision, its corresponding occurrence on the Design structure will be highlighted. Similarly, on selecting the aligned Part, the occurrence on Part structure will get highlighted.

•    Use case 2:
Engineering BOM structure and Design structure is opened in CBA page. This operation will render the update panel with the following information:
Modified Part Revision, Aligned Design Revision and the update action to be performed on the Design Structure. On selecting the modified Part revision, its corresponding occurrence on the Part structure will be highlighted. Similarly, on selecting the aligned Design, the occurrence on Design structure will get highlighted.

ParameterInfo.description: The selected ChangeNoticeRevision from primary work area in Active Workspace. When an active change is not selected, it will be NULL.
The Awb0Element containing the source BOMLine.
The Awb0Element containing the target BOMLine.

Operation.description: This operation retrieves a summary of update actions when a source structure (Design or Part) is modified in a specified input change revision. The response for this operation encompasses information about the modified source, its aligned target (Design or Part), and potential update actions, such as revise, create, and reuse applicable to the target. For each solution item in the change, the update action for the aligned target item is determined based on the change action. Additionally, façade objects for the modified source and aligned target are computed to highlight occurrences in both the source and target structures.
Operation.name: getUpdateActionsSummary2
Operation.returnDescription:
The response structure GetUpdateActionSummaryResponse which contains list of information to be rendered on the update Panel.
Following partial errors will be thrown:
• 427007 – The given sourceOccurrence is not a valid Design or Part.
• 427008 – The given targetOccurrence is not a valid Design or Part.
• 233004 – The given changeNoticeRevision is not a valid type.
Operation.useCase:
This operation is invoked in the following use-cases:

Use Case 1:
When the design structure and part structure are opened in a cad-bom alignment (CBA) page, this operation renders the update panel with the following information:
- Modified DesignRevision
- Aligned PartRevision
- Update action to be performed on the part structure
Selecting the tile in update panel highlights its corresponding occurrence in the design structure and in the part structure for the DesignRevision and its aligned PartRevision.

Use Case 2:
When the part structure and design structure are opened in a CBA page, this operation renders the update panel with the following information:
- Modified PartRevision
- Aligned DesignRevision
- Update action to be performed on the design Structure
Selecting the tile in update panel highlights its corresponding occurrence in both the design structure and the part structure for the DesignRevision and its aligned PartRevision.

Operation.description:
This operation performs update on the target BOM structure as per the actions specified in the input criteria when the source structure undergoes a change. The operation identifies aligned target structure based on input data and updates the target structure as per specified actions in the input. This operation is supported for below source and target type combinations:
Source Type Target Type
Design BOM Engineering BOM
Engineering BOM Design BOM
Operation.name: updateTargetBOM
Operation.returnDescription:
The following partial errors may be returned as part of service data:
•    427010 The given source and target structures types are not valid.
•    427011 The given update action is not a valid action.
Operation.useCase:
Design BOM structure is opened in Content page.User performs a change in Design, which is aligned to Part. User specifies action to be performed on Part on the Design undergoing change.
User can take one of the actions like ReusePart, RevisePart, NewPart, NoPart, NoAction on the Part based on its maturity.
When user invokes updateTargetBOM operation, system performs the specified update action on the target Part structure.

• 427011 The given update action is not a valid action.
Operation.useCase: The design BOM structure is opened in the content page. The user initiates a change in the Design. The user specifies the action to be taken on the Part within the changing Design. The user can choose from the following actions: ReusePart, RevisePart, NewPart, NoPart, or NoAction, based on the maturity of the Part. Upon invoking this operation, the system executes the specified update action on the target part structure.

ServiceInterface.description:
The GenerateBOM service interface exposes the operations that enable generation of a type of BOM structure from another source structure type. For instance, generating an Engineering BOM from Design BOM and vice-versa.

Acronyms used:
    • BOM                Bill of material.
    • CBA                CAD-BOM alignment.
    • CBA Page        The Active workspace UI containing the engineering BOM and design BOM structures alongside each other.
ServiceInterface.name: GenerateBOM

StructElement.description:
The action to be taken on a Part object when a Design object undergoes change.
The following actions are supported :
ReusePart - Reuse existing revision of Part.
RevisePart - Revise the Part currently aligned to the Design under change.
NewPart - Use a new Part for the Design under change.
NoPart - The Design under change does not need a Part.
NoAction - No action should be taken on the aligned Part.
